conbody.p: Use the power sunshade to block direct sunlight coming through the sunroof glass.

li.p: Push the sunroof switch rearward to the first detent position, the power sunshade automatically slides open.
Push the sunroof switch forward to the first detent position, the power sunshade automatically closes. However, if the sunroof glass is open, the glass will close first.

conbody.p: To stop the power sunshade at any point, push the sunroof switch in any direction.

note.p: Do not pull or push the power sunshade by hand as such action may damage the power sunshade or cause it to malfunction.
Wrinkles formed on the power sunshade are normal due to material characteristic.
